properties.name: Hotel Quinta do Marco
properties.tip: Where we celebrate – and your home for the weekend.

properties.name: Praia do Barril
properties.tip: Walk or take the little train across the lagoon to a wide sandy beach with the famous anchor cemetery.

properties.name: Ilha de Tavira
properties.tip: A long island beach, a short ferry ride from Tavira across the Ria Formosa.

properties.name: Cacela Velha
properties.tip: A tiny whitewashed village on a cliff above the lagoon – one of the prettiest views in the Algarve.

properties.name: Tavira Castle
properties.tip: Climb the old walls for a view over the rooftops and the river Gilão.

properties.name: The Roman bridge
properties.tip: The old bridge over the Gilão, right in the heart of town – made for an evening stroll.

properties.name: Santa Luzia
properties.tip: A fishing village known as Portugal’s octopus capital – order the polvo.

properties.name: Mercado da Ribeira
properties.tip: The old riverside market hall, with cafés and terraces by the water.
